scope: Phase 10C physical discovery of one atomic left-button drag lifecycle against a test-owned AppKit fixture before any public pointer.drag contract is introduced

fixture.type: temporary AppKit window with ProbeView and hit-test-transparent movable marker
fixture.independentObserver: ProbeView mouseDown/mouseDragged/mouseUp handlers plus marker geometry

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment cannot execute the controlled drag fixture.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Drag down/dragged/up delivery, fixture consequence, required release cleanup, or pointer restoration fails.
resultPolicy.PASS: The complete drag lifecycle is observed in the test-owned AppKit fixture, the marker consequence is observed, no emergency release is needed on the success path, and pointer restoration succeeds.

nextStepOnPass: Use this discovery evidence to freeze a narrow atomic primary-display pointer.drag public contract and validate that public runtime/SDK path with an independent test-owned fixture.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not introduce or promote pointer.drag.
